description: Read the house's University Network page for a country, US state or city, fetched live from living-bread.org/universities: a short summary of Christian life at universities there and links to the campus and region pages within it (up to 14). Use for student questions ("Christian community at universities in Kenya", "churches near campus in California"). place is matched to a country page first, then to a region within it, then to a city page; give one place, not a list. It returns page links, not a structured list of student groups; for churches by distance use find_churches_near, for groups to join use communities_to_join. Not held returns matched null with the countries held. Access: no sign-in; shared limit of 300 requests a minute per IP.

place.description: A country, US state or city by name: "Japan", "California", "Nairobi".

name: universities

attribution.description: Credit line for the data: The Living Bread (living-bread.org).

content_layers.description: Which fields are Scripture and which are human interpretation or reflection.

entries.description: Up to 14 campus, region or city pages within it.

evidence.description: Present when Scripture was read: translation, canon, corpus version, attribution, and a SHA-256 per passage.

freshness.description: How current the answer is: kind (scheduled | recently_observed | verified_live | record), retrieved_at, available_now (true only when activity was verified live).

ids.description: Up to 25 ids found in this answer, for follow-up calls.

license.description: License URL of the returned data (CC BY 4.0 unless stated).

matched.description: Path of the page used, or null when none was held.

next_actions.description: Up to 4 links the person can open next.

ok.description: Always true on a successful answer (errors come back as isError, never here).

result_state.description: "empty" when nothing matched (count 0, no results); the text then says so plainly.

source_url.description: The first public web page this answer came from or points to.

suggestions.description: When matched is null: country pages held.

visibility.description: "public" for shared data, "yours" for the signed-in believer's own data.

title: Christian community at a university
